common_fields.name: model
common_fields.detail: Optional on a primitive route. Omit to choose the lowest eligible estimate. The model route takes its slug in the URL.

common_fields.name: account_id
common_fields.detail: Required for browser sessions. Bearer keys carry their account.

common_fields.name: max_estimated_cost_micros
common_fields.detail: Optional nonnegative ceiling for the whole job estimate in USD micros. 1000000 means one USD.

common_fields.name: dry_run
common_fields.detail: Validate, select, and save a canceled job without contacting a provider.

image.label: Image

fields.name: task
fields.detail: Choose text generation or reference-based editing.

fields.name: prompt
fields.detail: Nonblank text. Maximum 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: size
fields.detail: Exact output pixel dimensions. Use with models that advertise fixed sizes.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.detail: Requested width-to-height ratio. Available on models that expose relative sizing.

fields.name: resolution
fields.detail: Requested output resolution tier. Available values depend on the model.

fields.name: quality
fields.detail: Rendering effort on models that expose a quality control.

fields.name: output_format
fields.detail: Requested image encoding on models that offer a choice.

fields.name: image_inputs
fields.detail: Ordered edit references. Supply 1–16 uploaded images for image_edit.

fields.name: mask
fields.detail: Optional edit mask for image_inputs[0].

fields.name: input_fidelity
fields.detail: How closely edited images should follow the references.

rules: text_to_image takes no image_inputs, mask, or input_fidelity.
image_edit requires 1–16 image_inputs. A mask applies to the first image.
Supply either size or aspect_ratio. Model pages specify which sizing controls are supported.

example.prompt: Studio photograph of a cobalt cup on pale stone

video.label: Video
video.summary: Generate a clip from text or a starting image.

fields.name: task
fields.detail: Choose text or image conditioning.

fields.name: prompt
fields.detail: Nonblank text. Maximum 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: negative_prompt
fields.detail: Nonblank avoidance guidance, maximum 32,000 UTF-8 bytes. Available on Veo.

fields.name: image_input
fields.detail: An uploaded file owned by the calling account. Required for image-conditioned tasks.

fields.name: resolution
fields.detail: Requested video resolution.

fields.name: duration_seconds
fields.detail: Requested clip length in seconds.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.detail: Requested width-to-height ratio.

rules: image_input is required for image_to_video and excluded for text_to_video.
On Veo, 1080p and 4k require 8 seconds. If duration_seconds is omitted, TokenCraft selects 8 seconds for these tiers.
Gemini Omni Flash supports aspect ratio and image conditioning. Output length and resolution are model-controlled.

example.prompt: Slow tracking shot through a ceramic studio

audio.label: Audio
audio.summary: The request contract for speech synthesis, music, and sound effects.

fields.name: task
fields.detail: Choose the kind of audio to synthesize.

fields.name: prompt
fields.detail: Nonblank text. Maximum 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: voice
fields.detail: Voice identifier for speech synthesis. Model pages will list accepted voices.

fields.name: duration_seconds
fields.detail: Positive clip length for music or sound effects.

fields.name: output_format
fields.detail: Audio encoding.

rules: For speech, prompt contains the text to speak. Use voice only for speech.
Speech length follows the supplied text. Use duration_seconds for music and sound effects.

3d.label: 3D mesh
3d.summary: The request contract for generating a mesh from text or an image.

fields.name: task
fields.detail: Choose text or image conditioning.

fields.name: prompt
fields.detail: Nonblank text. Maximum 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: image_input
fields.detail: An uploaded file owned by the calling account. Required for image-conditioned tasks.

fields.name: output_format
fields.detail: Mesh container.

rules: image_input is required for image_to_3d and excluded for text_to_3d.

world.label: World
world.summary: The request contract for generating a spatial scene.

fields.name: prompt

fields.name: output_format
fields.detail: Gaussian-splat container.

example.prompt: A small ceramics workshop at room scale

text.label: Text
text.summary: Generate a text completion on the local provider-routing profile.

fields.name: model
fields.detail: Use a chat-capable alias from the local model catalog.

fields.name: messages
fields.detail: Supply 1–16 plain-text messages with role and content, including at least one user message.

fields.name: stream
fields.detail: Return server-sent events when true.

fields.name: stream_options
fields.detail: With streaming enabled, set include_usage to request a final usage event when both token counts are available.

fields.name: n
fields.detail: The chat endpoint supports one completion per request.

fields.name: max_completion_tokens
fields.detail: Output token ceiling, from 1 to 64000. max_tokens is a compatibility alias. Supply only one.

fields.name: temperature
fields.detail: Sampling temperature, from 0 to 2 inclusive.

fields.name: top_p
fields.detail: Nucleus sampling threshold, from 0 to 1 inclusive.

rules: Message role must be system, user, or assistant.
Use a key with request submission permission. Streaming uses server-sent events.

messages.content: Describe a cobalt cup in one sentence.

gpt_image.detail: Fixed pixel sizes, rendering effort, and explicit output encoding. Fidelity and mask are edit-only.
rules: For image_edit, supply 1–16 image_inputs. Leave them out for text_to_image.
A mask applies to image_inputs[0].
Use input_fidelity only for image_edit.

gpt_image_2.detail: Fixed pixel sizes, rendering effort, and explicit output encoding. Mask is edit-only.
rules: For image_edit, supply 1–16 image_inputs. Leave them out for text_to_image.
A mask applies to image_inputs[0].

gemini_image.detail: Aspect ratio and edit references. The model controls output resolution and encoding.
rules: For image_edit, supply 1–16 image_inputs. Leave them out for text_to_image.

gemini_image_tiered.detail: Aspect ratio, edit references, and an explicit resolution tier. The model controls encoding.
rules: For image_edit, supply 1–16 image_inputs. Leave them out for text_to_image.

veo.detail: Explicit video duration, output resolution, framing, and optional starting image.
rules: Supply image_input for image_to_video. Leave it out for text_to_video.
For 1080p or 4k, duration_seconds must be 8. TokenCraft selects 8 if omitted.

veo_lite.detail: Explicit video duration, output resolution, framing, and optional starting image.
rules: Supply image_input for image_to_video. Leave it out for text_to_video.
For 1080p, duration_seconds must be 8. TokenCraft selects 8 if omitted.

omni.detail: Specify framing and an optional starting image. Describe the desired duration and avoidance guidance in the prompt.
rules: Supply image_input for image_to_video. Leave it out for text_to_video.
Include desired pacing, duration, or avoidance guidance in the prompt.

gemini_image_flash.detail: Aspect ratio, edit references, and an explicit resolution tier. The model controls encoding.
rules: For image_edit, supply 1–16 image_inputs. Leave them out for text_to_image.
